metrics.name: slot_copy_accuracy
metrics.note: content preserved through realization; has headroom

metrics.name: empty_rate
metrics.note: REGRESSION GUARD - abstention floor; silence must not read as skill

metrics.name: scored
metrics.note: REGRESSION GUARD - items that produced any text at all

rationale: B = fluency. Selected against criteria written BEFORE the choice, not by intuition: (1) a deterministic runnable evaluation, (2) outside the A work area -- fluency has zero commits in the last 24h while scene_model had 17 and was disqualified on that ground, (3) plausibly standing on discrimination-shaped machinery (register selection, delexicalisation, clause planning). It is also maximally distant in SUBJECT MATTER from A (referent disambiguation in a knowledge graph vs. generating English), so a positive reading cannot be a near-neighbour effect. HEADROOM, stated so the reading is not oversold: faithfulness is already 1.0 and empty_rate 0.0 at freeze time -- those two cannot improve and serve only as REGRESSION GUARDS. Only slot_copy_accuracy (0.980) and fluency_proxy (0.955) can move upward, and both are near ceiling, so a genuine transfer effect here will be small and a large jump should be treated as suspicious rather than as success.
